Suppress CVE-2020-29582 only when Dependency-Check maps a dependency to the overly broad Kotlin CPE "jetbrains:kotlin" (known false positive for kotlin-stdlib, kotlin-stdlib-jdk7, kotlin-stdlib-jdk8).
Suppress Spring Framework 6.2.18 false positives / accepted risk for release

CVE-2026-41006 and CVE-2026-41007 affect spring-hateoas 1.5.6. Fixed in spring-hateoas 2.5.3+ and 3.0.4+, but no OSS fix exists for the 1.5.x line. Accepted risk pending upgrade of spring-hateoas or migration to Spring Boot 4 (which brings spring-hateoas 3.x).
Suppress spring-security-crypto 6.5.10 false positives / accepted risk for release.

jackson-databind CVEs (CWE-184 array-subtype allowlist bypass, SSRF via eager DNS resolution in InetSocketAddress deserialization, and CWE-915 case-insensitive-property mass-assignment bypass). Fixed in 2.18.8/2.18.9, 2.21.4/2.21.5, 3.1.4. Upgrade will resolve.

False positive: CVE-2026-54399 and CVE-2026-54428 affect Apache HttpComponents Core5 (org.apache.httpcomponents.core5:httpcore5, 5.4.2 and earlier / 5.5-beta1 and earlier) - a DoS in the async/HTTP2 HTTP/1.1 message parser. This project depends on the legacy org.apache.httpcomponents:httpcore 4.4.x artifact, a different, unrelated codebase that shares an overly broad CPE (apache:httpcomponents_core) with httpcore5 in the NVD data.
CVE-2026-49844 - log4j 2.25.4 false positive / accepted risk pending fix. Version managed by Spring Boot 3 BOM.

CVE-2026-66299 applies to the Tomcat WebSocket chat example. This Spring Boot application uses embedded Tomcat and does not package or deploy the Tomcat examples web application. Apache states that deployments without the examples application are not affected. Remove after upgrading to Tomcat 10.1.58 or later.

Spring Framework 6.2.x is EOL with no public fix for these CVEs. Fixed in Spring Framework 7.0.9 (Spring Boot 4.0.8+). Upgrading to Spring Boot 4.x is required for a public OSS fix.
